scripts.build: deno task generate && deno run -A build/main.ts build
scripts.check: deno task typecheck && deno task test && deno task build
scripts.dev: deno task generate && deno run -A build/main.ts dev
scripts.test: deno run -A scripts/test-highlighting.ts && deno run -A scripts/test-reference.ts && deno run -A scripts/test-listing.ts && deno run -A scripts/test-rules.ts && deno run -A scripts/test-presentation.ts
scripts.typecheck: deno run -A npm:typescript/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && deno run -A npm:typescript/tsc -p build/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.generate: deno run -A scripts/sync-assets.ts && deno run -A scripts/generate-release.ts && deno run -A scripts/generate-content.ts
